Definition: Bukki, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bukki is the name of two Israelites: Bukki the son of Jogli, a prince of Dan who helped divide the land, and Bukki the son of Abishua, a priest in Aaron's line and an ancestor of Ezra. The name covers a prince and a priest, two very different callings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God uses both princes and priests, and Bukki's two bearers show that one name can serve Him in more than one way.
RelatedPeople: Bukki, Son of Jogli; Bukki, Son of Abishua
